flowchart TD
  subgraph API["API"]
    A["PhoneNumberKit/PhoneNumberUtility.swift"]
    B["PhoneNumberKit/PhoneNumber.swift"]
  end
  subgraph ENG["Analyse et format"]
    C["PhoneNumberKit/ParseManager.swift"]
    D["PhoneNumberKit/PhoneNumberParser.swift"]

  end
  subgraph META["Metadonnees"]
    G["PhoneNumberKit/MetadataManager.swift"]

    I["PhoneNumberKit/UI/PhoneNumberTextField.swift"]

explication: PhoneNumberUtility delegue l'analyse a ParseManager et PhoneNumberParser, qui produisent un PhoneNumber en consultant les metadonnees chargees par MetadataManager depuis PhoneNumberMetadata.json. Le formatage passe par Formatter, et PartialFormatter alimente le champ PhoneNumberTextField.
source: Claude, d'après l'arbre du dépôt et le README
explication_en: PhoneNumberUtility delegates parsing to ParseManager and PhoneNumberParser, which produce a PhoneNumber by consulting the metadata loaded by MetadataManager from PhoneNumberMetadata.json. Formatting goes through Formatter, and PartialFormatter feeds the PhoneNumberTextField field.
